subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】parents 父母; cousin 表/堂兄弟姐妹; uncle 叔/舅; aunt 姨/姑; baby brother 婴儿小弟; doctor 医生; cook 厨师; driver 司机; farmer 农民; nurse 护士
【重点句型】How many people? 多少人？ What's your ...'s job? 你……是做什么工作的？ He's/She's a ... 他/她是一名…… My family has ... people. 我家有……口人。 This is my ... 这是我的……
【A Let's talk】Amy: How many people are there in your family? Chen Jie: Three. My parents and me. Amy: What's your father's job? Chen Jie: He's a doctor. My mother is a nurse.
【Read and write】This is my family. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. My uncle is a driver. My aunt is a cook. My cousin is a student. I love my big family.
key_points: What's your ...'s job? 你……是做什么工作的？
My family has ... people. 我家有……口人。
This is my ... 这是我的……
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
